label: nx_first_msg_100
text:
Brilliant! Access was successful![CLEAR]
One small step for me, but one grand step for
Pokémon HOME!

label: nx_first_msg_101
text:
Hm...?[CLEAR]
Oh, forgive me!
I’m not even on-screen!

label: nx_first_msg_121
text:
I am the great Pokémon researcher—Grand Oak![CLEAR]
A pleasure to make your acquaintance!

label: nx_first_msg_122
text:
Now then... Forgive me for being so abrupt,
but my dream is to create a Pokédex that...[CLEAR]
includes all the Pokémon in the world!

label: nx_first_msg_123
text:
Of course, if I’m being honest, it’s very
difficult for me to accomplish this alone.

label: nx_first_msg_124
text:
But, just right now...
I’ve gained an absolutely grand ally!

label: nx_first_msg_130
text:
Why, you, of course![CLEAR]
I have a favor to ask!

label: nx_first_msg_131
text:
I’ve developed this Pokémon HOME, and I want you to bring
lots and lots of Pokémon here!

label: nx_first_msg_140
text:
But I’m sure there’s still lots you don’t know about
Pokémon HOME.

label: nx_first_msg_141
text:
No problem at all! Just ask Poké Boy if you
run into any issues!
